newsitem.title: USA: Louisville feeder cattle prices steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Louisville feeder cattle prices steady - USDA.

text.p: Feeder steers and heifers were steady, compared to Monday's close, USDA said.

Feeder Steers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs few 76.00-83.00, fleshy 73.00-74.00. Medium and Large 2 300-400 lbs 80.50-82.50; 400-500 lbs 76.00-79.00. Holsteins - Large 2 300-400 lbs 66.00-72.00; 400-500 lbs 65.00-71.00, package 533 lbs 64.50; package 646 lbs 61.25; 12 head 834 lbs 59.75.

Feeder Heifers - Medium and Large 1 600-700 lbs 68.00-70.00. Small 1 package 380 lbs 78.50; 400-500 lbs 64.00-74.00. Medium and Large 2 300-400 lbs 74.00-78.50; 400-500 lbs 70.00-75.50; 500- 600 lbs 67.50-71.00. Cattle and Calves Receipts - 533
